note: BH-9065. The memory of a `model`-class pool machine (see VM_CLASS). Per-project row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.vm_memory_mb_model`. shared-cpu sizes: a multiple of 256, 256..2048 MB per CPU (shared-cpu-2x: 512..4096). performance sizes: the VM_MEMORY_MB rule. A pair that breaks the rule launches performance-8x/16384 and logs one `VM size row refused` line.
